text:
Riley (People Ops): Quick update: we've published a "handbook snapshot" that bundles recent policy tweaks (bereavement, parental leave clarity, and the remote-work FAQ). Need managers to confirm they've read + that direct reports completed the 20-min compliance micro-course by Jun 14. Tracker & links below.

Carlos (Benefits): Where's the tracker?

Riley (People Ops): Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/handbook-snapshot-2026. Confluence summary + redline: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/snapshot-jun-2026

Mei (Legal): Approved the redline. Left one note about bereavement duration language; changed "immediate family" to a bulleted definition to avoid ambiguity.

Priya (Recruiting): Heads-up: we need to update offer templates for part-time parental leave language. I'll push a PR to the templates repo by EOD.

Jordan (Eng): Are managers expected to field accommodation requests? We get a few return-to-work notes mid-cycle.

Riley (People Ops): Yes. Managers should escalate accommodations to People Ops (column "1:1 support" in the tracker) and we will coordinate with Legal/Benefits. Added a short manager checklist in the sheet.

Carlos (Benefits): The benefits note: new eligibility for phased return after parental leave (see section 4b). Benefit enrollment window extended to 60 days for conversions.

Mei (Legal): Also uploaded an FAQ snippet on contractor-to-fulltime conversions. It's in the confluence page under "FAQ: hires & conversions".

Priya (Recruiting): Added a reminder to candidate offer checklist to flag leave eligibility differences.

Jordan (Eng): OK I'll remind my team. Can managers bulk-acknowledge once everyone completes the course?

Riley (People Ops): Yes — managers can mark team completed in the tracker but please only after verifying. We'll audit a random sample.

reminder-bot: Auto-reminder scheduled: All employees will receive training nudge on May 31, Jun 7, and final nudge Jun 12.

Carlos (Benefits): Is the training the same as the usual compliance bundle?

Riley (People Ops): It's a targeted 20-min module: "Handbook snapshot + benefits highlights" + 5-question quiz. Link in tracker. Completion recorded in LMS.

Mei (Legal): Suggest we include a short section in next week's HR drop about how the bereavement definition works across jurisdictions. I'll draft a few bullets.

Priya (Recruiting): If we change offers, anyone accepted before the change — do we honor the old terms?

Riley (People Ops): Yes — change is not retroactive for executed offers. Clause added to the confluence page.

Jordan (Eng): Thanks. Putting a note in my team's next all-hands.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks all. Final ask: managers, confirm in the tracker by Jun 16 that you've reviewed the snapshot with your team. If you need a walkthrough, drop a time in column "Manager walkthrough" and we'll book it. :spiral_calendar:

reminder-bot: Manager confirmation digest will be emailed Jun 17 to people ops and team leads (status: queued).
__notes: Slack thread: handbook snapshot, manager confirmations, training tracking, and policy clarifications. Messages are chronological and prefixed by sender names.
